changelog.summary: Universal owner editing for the Generic CMS, including WordPress-imported posts. Fixes the live slug defect where typing a title produced the first keystroke as the slug ('t' for 'Teine test post'): auto-generation now follows the complete title, stops at the first manual edit, offers explicit regeneration, transliterates Estonian/Unicode letters deterministically, and prevents duplicates across imported and CMS-authored content. Published slugs are locked; changing one is an explicit advanced action that preserves the old URL as an alias and keeps the old QDN resource. Imported WordPress posts are edited through a versioned conflict-aware qms-cms-edit-overlay@1 overlay that never modifies the imported resources and survives incremental sync. Adds gallery caption/alt/order editing, full draft/preview/cancel states and an unsaved-change guard.

desktop.changelog: Rebuilt with CMS 0.8.0-alpha.6. Desktop sources are otherwise unchanged; the desktop artifact carries the new CMS template and the new release identity.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.6: fixes first-keystroke slug generation ('t' for 'Teine test post') with a pure auto-slug reducer, full-title updates, manual-edit stop, Regenerate slug, Unicode/Estonian transliteration, deterministic duplicate suffixes and cross-source collision checks. Adds owner editing for imported WordPress posts through a versioned conflict-aware qms-cms-edit-overlay@1 overlay (keep-local/accept-upstream; imported resources never modified), published-slug advanced change with aliases and resource preservation, slug-health repair reporting, gallery caption/alt/order/membership editing, unsaved-change guards and clearer draft/pending/published/partial/ambiguous states. See docs/migration-studio/CMS-EDITING-AND-SLUGS.md.
